rasasi hawas.rawText: One of the best summer perfumes. I would highly recommend this product. It lasts a very long time.
Smells amazing, definitely getting compliments. Very fresh and aquatic.
Good projection but it gave me a headache after a while. A bit too synthetic for my taste.
Bottle leaked during shipping. The fragrance is fine but packaging is terrible.
Absolutely love the plum and aquatic notes. Beast mode performance, lasts 10+ hours.

rasasi hawas ice.rawText: The new ice version is incredibly fresh. Better than the original in my opinion for high heat.
Performance is weaker than the original Hawas. It disappears after 4 hours.
Very citrusy and minty opening. Great for gym and casual wear. Highly recommend.
Overpriced for what it is. Smells too similar to Invictus Aqua but costs more.

iphone 16.rawText: The display is incredibly crisp and the new camera control button is a game changer for photography.
Battery drains extremely fast after the latest update. Barely lasts half a day with normal usage.
The phone overheats significantly during gaming sessions. Thermal throttling is very noticeable on the base model.
Camera quality in low light is disappointing compared to competitors. Night mode processing takes too long.
The 60Hz display feels outdated in 2024. Scrolling is noticeably less smooth than 120Hz phones at this price.
